card.law_is_about: A tax exemption for qualifying employment income after statutory retirement age.
card.they_want: Reject the Aktivrente and improve working conditions and support for healthy ageing instead.
card.they_claim: The German microcensus surveys 0.1 percent of the resident population.
card.the_problem: Its basic annual sample is about 1 percent. This is a narrow survey-description error, not a demonstrated error in the author’s estimates.

draft.title: Entwurf eines Gesetzes zur steuerlichen Förderung von Arbeitnehmerinnen und Arbeitnehmern im Rentenalter (Aktivrentengesetz)
draft.version_check: The submission title expressly identifies BT 21/2673. Exact operative Article 1 number 1, physical 7, and explanatory scope were read. No date beyond publication for the hearing is inferred.

claim_quote.original: Im Mikrozensus werden 0,1 Prozent der Wohnbevölkerung in Deutschland befragt.
claim_quote.translation_en: Translation: The microcensus surveys 0.1 percent of the resident population in Germany.

request_quote.translation_en: Translation of request fragment: the Aktivrente should be rejected.

counter_quote.original: Rund 1 % der Bevölkerung wird jährlich stellvertretend für die gesamte Bevölkerung zu seinen Lebensbedingungen befragt.
counter_quote.translation_en: Translation: Around 1 percent of the population is surveyed annually about living conditions, representing the population as a whole.

correction: Describe the basic annual microcensus selection as approximately 1 percent, not 0.1 percent. Separate this from the realised response, individual subprogrammes, scientific-use-file subsamples and the author’s own filtered analysis sample, none of whose exact sizes is established by the correction.
effect: Corrects a background description of the data used in the argument. A larger basic survey sample would ordinarily support rather than undermine potential statistical precision, but the policy estimates cannot be recalculated from this sentence.
limits: No finding that the author’s weighted pension or employment totals are wrong, or that every variable or analytic subgroup uses the full 1 percent. Sampling fractions alone do not establish representativeness, causal validity or policy effectiveness. No intent is inferred.
context_and_alternatives: Full 10-page author submission read. The adjacent text discusses large case numbers and compulsory participation, then explicitly qualifies employment, pension-type and age-group limitations. Those qualifications must remain visible.

Some microcensus components genuinely use smaller subsamples. Destatis’s 2012 quality discussion explicitly distinguishes the 1 percent basic sample from a 0.1 percent retirement-transition supplementary module. GESIS metadata independently documents this history and later integrated subprogrammes.

A reference to a smaller component or an editorial decimal slip is plausible. However, the printed sentence describes the microcensus generally and does not identify a special 0.1 percent module. The author’s tables span general pension and employment status in 2012 and 2021.

The current Destatis methods webpage corroborates the long-standing design. Historical 2012 primary documentation and the MZG basic-sample rule prevent treating a later methodology change as the correction.

The separate parenthetical comment about regular retirement pension can be read as distinguishing pension types rather than excluding people who defer pension receipt. No additional eligibility-error finding is promoted.
materiality_explanation: Minor: a factor-ten error in the background sampling fraction, but no demonstrated effect on a published estimate, standard error or policy conclusion. The size of the numerical factor is separate from materiality.
direction_explanation: Null: correcting this background description does not establish a policy-direction effect. It should not be coded as strengthening opposition merely because it appears in an opposing submission.

confidence.text_source_mismatch: high for the general microcensus basic-sample description; exact analytic subsample unknown

verification.visual: Original author physicalpage 1 rendered and visually inspected; no OCR numeral ambiguity.
verification.quotation_budget: Author claim and request together 15 words; counterquote 19 words from Destatis methods webpage.
